cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_sends: Moving {session} to {device} mid-conversation sends its working files there:
cli.sessions_move_workset.warning_stays: Moving {session} to {device} mid-conversation does not bring its working files yet. They stay on {source}:
cli.sessions_move_workset.brings_summary: {worktrees, plural, one {# worktree} other {# worktrees}} · {commits, plural, one {# unpushed commit} other {# unpushed commits}} · {files, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}} · {size}
cli.sessions_move_workset.advice_sends: Only continue if {device} should receive these files.
cli.sessions_move_workset.advice_stays: Only continue if you can finish or push this work on {source}, or you do not need it on {device}.
cli.sessions_move_workset.prompt_stays: Move {session} to {device} and leave these working files on {source}? [y/N]
cli.sessions_move_workset.aborted: Not moved: the working files were not confirmed.
cli.sessions_move_workset.needs_confirma: This conversation has working files on {source}. Review them with --dry-run, then re-run with --confirm-working-set {digest} (or --yes), or with --without-working-set to leave them there.
cli.sessions_move_workset.changed: The working files changed since they were shown; here is the current list.
cli.sessions_move_workset.unknown: The working files on {source} could not be read (repository: {repo}), so nothing was moved. Fix that repository, or re-run with --without-working-set to leave every working file there.
cli.sessions_move_workset.unsupported: {device} runs an older lop that cannot list this conversation's working files. Update lop there, or re-run with --without-working-set to leave them on that device.
cli.sessions_move_workset.none: No working files: this move needs no confirmation.
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_not_tr: Working files were not transferred: {count, plural, one {# worktree stays} other {# worktrees stay}} on {device}.
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_withou: Working files were left on {device}, as requested.
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_keep: The copy on {device} does not have this conversation's working files; they stay on {source}.
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_dry_run: show the conversation's working files (git worktrees, unpushed and uncommitted work) this move would affect, and move nothing
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_confirm: confirm the working files shown by --dry-run: pass its working_set.scope_digest
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_without: move the conversation and leave its working files where they are
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_yes: confirm the working files without a prompt (for scripts)
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.contend: another live conversation is using it
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.outside: it is outside your home folder
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.in_prog: a merge, rebase or cherry-pick is in progress
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.history: its unpushed commits contain secret-shaped content; push or rewrite them first
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.over_ca: it is larger than one move can send
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.destina: that path is already used on the destination
the destination cannot clone its repository; share a credential with it first
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.unsuppo: the other device cannot receive it
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.not_tra: this version of lop does not transfer working files yet
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.history: its unpushed commits are too large to check for secrets; push them first
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.unsafe_: its path is not safe to recreate on another device
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.insuffi: the destination does not have enough free disk space
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_f: {device} cannot fetch {remote} with its own access
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_p: {device} can fetch {remote} but cannot push to it
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_cannot_c: {device} will not use {remote}: the address is not allowed, or git is missing there
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_https_re: SSH does not reach it from {device}; HTTPS does: {url}
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_remedy: To give {device} GitHub access, run this on the device that lends it: {command}
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_unknown: Could not check whether {device} can reach these repositories; it may run an older lop.
cli.sessions_move_workset.prereq_missing: {device} is missing: {tools} (these projects need them; the move still works)
cli.sessions_move_workset.prereq_team_br: {device} is not enrolled in Team Bridge, which this conversation uses (the move still works)
cli.sessions_move_workset.help_no_engage: do not resume an active conversation on the destination (by default it starts there with a note about its working files)
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_resume: The conversation was active, so it resumed on {device} with a note about what stayed behind.
cli.sessions_move_workset.unsupported_de: {device} runs an older lop that cannot pass on your answer about the working files, so nothing was moved. Update lop on {device}, then try again.
cli.sessions_move_workset.unknown_cause: Git's reason: {cause}. To see it yourself, run: git -C {repo} status
cli.sessions_move_workset.cause.not_a_re: its .git entry points at a repository that is missing
cli.sessions_move_workset.cause.dubious_: the repository belongs to another user (git's safe.directory check)
cli.sessions_move_workset.cause.object_c: some of its git objects are damaged
cli.sessions_move_workset.cause.git_miss: git is not installed, or not on lop's PATH
cli.sessions_move_workset.cause.timeout: git took too long to answer
cli.sessions_move_workset.mentioned: Only mentioned in this conversation, so not included: {paths}
cli.sessions_move_workset.digest_mismatc: That --confirm-working-set digest does not match this conversation's current working files (it may be mistyped, or the files changed since --dry-run). Here is the current list.
cli.sessions_move_workset.desktop_refuse: The working files on {source} need your decision before this conversation moves to {device}, so nothing was moved.
cli.sessions_move_workset.unknown_card: The working files on {source} could not be read (repository: {repo}), so nothing was moved. Fix that repository, or choose “{button}” below to leave every working file there.
cli.sessions_move_workset.unsupported_ca: {device} runs an older lop that cannot list this conversation's working files. Update lop there, or choose “{button}” below to leave them on that device.
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_asked: {device} was asked whether it can reach these remotes; it was sent only their addresses and build-file names, no paths or branches.
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_transf: Working files arrived from {source}: {count, plural, one {# worktree} other {# worktrees}} restored here.
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_pendin: {count, plural, one {# worktree is} other {# worktrees are}} not restored yet; this device retries when its relay restarts, and {source} still has the files.
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_recipe: To recreate its dependencies, run in {cwd}: {run}
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_rewrit: Used a remote address this device can reach: {detail}
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.primary: the destination has no copy of this repository and could not clone it
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.restore: the files arrived but could not be restored yet
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.snapsho: its state could not be captured on the source (an empty branch or a bare repository)
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.restore: this device does not accept a repository at that path (a hidden, system, command or dependency folder, or outside mesh.move.working_set_roots)
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.url_ref: its remote is not a public HTTPS or SSH address this device will clone from
cli.sessions_move_workset.receipt_branch: Moved the existing branch {branch} forward from {old} to {new}, as this device had left it.
cli.sessions_move_workset.import_not_gra: {device} has not allowed this device to send it working files, so they stay here and only the conversation moves. To allow it, run this on {device}: {command}
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.import_: the destination has not allowed this device to send it working files
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.too_man: the move carried more worktrees than the destination accepts at once
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.clone_p: the destination clones a missing repository only into a folder that already holds your repositories (or set mesh.move.working_set_roots)
cli.sessions_move_workset.reason.kept_as: it stays on the source, as confirmed for this move
cli.sessions_move_workset.probe_refused_: {device} will not contact {remote}: its address is refused by policy (not a public host)
